title: Polished Chrome Towel Bar, 18-Inch Wall-Mounted Powder Coated Iron Pipe Style, Pipeline Collection, Allied Brass
description: Towel bar for bathroom use with an industrial, pipe-style look in Polished Chrome, which delivers a bright, mirror-like sheen that coordinates effortlessly with chrome faucets and modern fixtures. This wall mount / wall-mounted towel bar is an 18-inch (18-inch, 18 inches, 18in) straight bar designed as a towel rack / towel holder for daily towel drying and storage. Center-to-center: 18 in. Overall product dimensions: 18 x 3 x 3.3 in (LxHxW) with 3.3 in projection; bar diameter 0.75 in. Material: iron with a highly durable powder coat for a clean finish and corrosion-free, rust-free performance. Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware with color coordinated mounting hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4". Weight capacity: 10 lb. Assembly required: False. Limited lifetime warranty. Ideal for matching pipeline and coordinating industrial bathroom hardware, pipe-style bath accessories, pipe-style accessories, and loft bathroom fixtures in the Pipeline collection by Allied Brass.
